display.purpose: Hero h1 only; balanced wrap, left eight columns.

headline.purpose: Every section h2 including the Close panel; nothing sits above it.

title.purpose: h3 for Why points, photo captions, Spaces cards, process steps.

body.purpose: Section-head paragraphs and process copy, 24–34em measure; 17/26px under 720px.

small.purpose: Supporting copy under h3s, caption lines, footer links, definition descriptions.

label.purpose: Process step numerals and Close-panel definition terms only; never a heading kicker.

control.purpose: Buttons and nav links; 17px in large buttons.

fonts.purpose: Metric-matched fallback so the layout does not shift before the variable font loads.

gradients.name: caption-scrim
gradients.purpose: Lower 62% of a photo panel, only where caption text sits on the photograph. The single gradient in the system.

translucency.name: nav-glass
translucency.value: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper) 88%, transparent); backdrop-filter: saturate(140%) blur(12px)

translucency.name: bottombar-glass
translucency.value: color-mix(in srgb, var(--greige) 90%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(12px)

translucency.name: chip-glass
translucency.value: color-mix(in srgb, var(--white) 82%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(8px)
translucency.purpose: Hero strip chips over the photograph.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Spring-out ease for every authored motion (reveal, photo hover, nav underline, bottom bar, scroller thumb).

motion.name: t-fast
motion.purpose: Button and step-button colour and transform transitions (linear ease).

motion.name: t-reveal
motion.purpose: Entry reveal: opacity 0 to 1 and translateY(18px) to none, staggered by --d (0.06s to 0.2s).

motion.name: reveal-offset
motion.purpose: Distance content settles upward on entry.

motion.name: photo-hover
motion.purpose: Linked photo panels on hover and focus-visible.

motion.name: nav-underline
motion.value: transform: scaleX(0) to scaleX(1), 0.25s var(--ease), origin left

motion.name: bottombar-slide
motion.purpose: Mobile bottom bar once the hero CTA leaves the viewport.

motion.name: drawing-draw
motion.value: stroke-dashoffset from measured length to 0; 1600 units/s, 30% overlap, 2.2s budget, linear
motion.purpose: Section drawing strokes draw along real path lengths; labels and cut-outs appear after --total.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce renders reveal, drawing, photo hover and bottom bar already settled; scroll-behavior auto

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Margin 32px, section 96px; section head stacks to 8 columns; services 6-col; process stacks; close panel stacks.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Margin 20px, gutter 16px, section 72px, nav 64px, body 17/26px; bottom bar on; hero 4:5; nav links hidden.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Why row collapses to one column.

layout.sectionHead: h2 columns 1–7, aside columns 9–12, align end, 24px row gap
layout.heroStage: 16:9 max-height 760px inside margins; 4:5 within 8px of the viewport edge on mobile
layout.focus: outline 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset 3px; border-radius 8px (pill on buttons)

narrative.northStar: The Product Catalogue for a Room
narrative.overview:
Simplex is presented the way a logistics product company presents its containers: one large, untinted photograph of the glazing itself under a plain headline, then photo-led panels for each service. The page itself is a quiet greige ground with three off-white steps and white cards; it has no accent hue at all. Every chromatic value on the page comes from a photograph, and the photographs are shown as they were taken. The charcoal ink does all the pointing: it is the text, the buttons, the icon discs, one dark card in a row, and the closing panel.

Density is generous and grid-led. Sections are long bands (128px of vertical padding at desktop) headed by a single h2 on the left seven columns and a short paragraph, sometimes with a button or a control, on the right four. There are no eyebrow labels, kickers or section numbers above headings: each zone is named by its literal noun in the heading and nothing else. Hierarchy is carried by one humanist sans, Source Sans 3, at exactly two weights, 600 for anything that names or acts and 400 for anything that explains.

The world rejects the fabricator default it was built against: no dark facade hero, no orange quote button, no icon-tile services, no box-shadows, no gradients except the scrim that makes photo captions legible. Depth is tonal (greige, sheet, paper, white) and linear (1px rules). Motion is a single grammar: content settles upward 18px as it enters, the technical section drawing draws itself along its real path lengths, and under reduced motion everything is simply already there.
keyCharacteristics: Four flat neutral surfaces (greige, sheet, paper, white) and one charcoal ink; photographs supply every other colour.
One typeface, two weights (600 / 400); tight negative tracking at display sizes, no tracked caps above headings.
12-column grid inside a 1440px wrap; section heads split 7 / 4; content sits 72px below the head.
Rounded photo panels and cards (14px), pill buttons, circular icon discs, a 24px closing panel; no shadows anywhere.
One 1.5px-stroke line-icon set drawn in a 24px box, always in ink or its inverse.
One reveal motion (18px settle, 0.9s, spring-out ease) plus a self-drawing technical section; everything settled under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Photographs Carry Colour Rule
rules.body: The palette has no accent hue. Any saturated colour on the page must come from an untinted photograph; never add a brand accent, tint an image, or colour an icon.

rules.name: The Band Ladder Rule
rules.body: Bands are greige, sheet or paper and adjacent bands never share a surface. White is reserved for objects sitting on a band (cards, caption cards, pills) and is never itself a band.

rules.name: The Ink Object Rule
rules.body: Charcoal is applied to objects, never to bands: buttons, discs, one dark card per row, and the rounded Close panel inside its paper band. There is no full-bleed dark section.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: 600 names and acts; 400 explains. No other weight is loaded or used, and no italic exists.

rules.name: The Headline-Alone Rule
rules.body: No eyebrow, kicker, slash-label or numeral sits above an h2 or h1 (user decision 2026-09-11). Sections are carried by the heading noun and the paragraph beside it.

rules.name: The Tracked-Caps Budget Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked type appears in exactly three places: the wordmark, the label role (step numerals, definition terms) and the annotations inside the technical drawing. Nowhere else.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never cast shadows, in any state. If an element needs to separate from its ground, step its surface one rung up the ladder or draw a 1px rule.

rules.name: The Scrim-Only Gradient Rule
rules.body: The single permitted gradient is the caption scrim under text on a photograph. No gradient is decorative.

rules.name: The Floating Chrome Rule
rules.body: Backdrop blur is reserved for elements that overlay scrolling content (nav, bottom bar, chips on the hero photo). Cards and bands are opaque.

dos: Do let the photographs be the only colour; keep the page to greige, sheet, paper, white and charcoal ink.
Do open every section with the same head: h2 in columns 1–7, paragraph and optional action in columns 9–12, content 72px below.
Do step surfaces up the ladder (greige, sheet, paper, white) when something needs to separate; adjacent bands must differ.
Do use Source Sans 3 at 600 for anything that names or acts and 400 for anything that explains, with -0.025em / -0.018em tracking on display and headline sizes.
Do keep charcoal to objects (buttons, discs, one card per row, the Close panel) and keep the Close panel's 24px radius concentric with its 14px photo at a 24px inset.
Do use the one reveal (opacity plus 18px settle, 0.9s, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), staggered by --d) for entering content and render it already settled under reduced motion.
Do put text over photographs only with the scrim (dark captions) or on a white caption card or pill.
Do draw icons as 1.5px round-capped line strokes in a 24px box in currentColor.
donts: Don't add a box-shadow to anything, in any state.
Don't add a gradient other than the caption scrim, or tint, duotone or overlay a photograph.
Don't place an eyebrow, kicker, slash-label, numeral or any tracked-caps line above an h1 or h2.
Don't introduce a brand accent, a second typeface, a third weight, or a monospace face.
Don't make a full-bleed dark band; charcoal sits inside a light band as an object.
Don't use hard corners or a radius other than 8px, 14px, 24px (Close panel only), a pill or a circle.
Don't add blur or translucency to cards or bands; it is reserved for chrome that overlays scrolling content.
Don't add a second motion grammar (parallax, marquee, bouncing CTAs); the settle reveal, the self-drawing section, the 1.03 photo hover and the bottom-bar slide are the entire vocabulary.
